text:
IncidentBot: @channel ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on gateway-prod (edge-gateway) starting at 2026-03-01T12:02:03Z. 5m error rate 8.2% (> threshold 1%). Pager: Aj Patel
Aj Patel: taking pager, investigating :eyes:
Maria Chen: i'm on logs/traffic — seeing spike pinned to backend pool 'model-inference-east'. a subset of requests hit timeout (~30s) and bubble up 502/504s.
Simon Lee: looking at telemetry — tail latencies align with KV cache misses after last prefix rollout. lots of cold misses to prefix keys for high-token requests to /v1/generate.
Aj Patel: can we route traffic to a cheaper/smaller variant to reduce backend pressure? propose temporary policy: prefer 'model-small-v2' for non-enterprise routes for 10m.
Dana Ortiz: agree on fallback; also suggest reducing edge fanout and tightening CB thresholds to avoid retry storms. max_fanout 20 -> 8, cb error pct 5% -> 3% for gateway.
Maria Chen: i'll push a routing canary now. will post deploy id.
deploy-bot: started deployment rtr-20260301-01 to api-gateway (canary 10%) — user: maria.
deploy-bot: canary healthy after 2m, promoting to 50%.
Maria Chen: canary shows 5xx drop in canary shard. promoting to 100%.
deploy-bot: deployment rtr-20260301-01 promoted to 100% (12:08 UTC) — route fallback to model-small-v2 active.
Simon Lee: quick metric snapshot: pre-change 5m 5xx=8.2%, post-change 5m 5xx=1.6%. median p95 latency down ~150ms. good signal.
Aj Patel: holding paging for 20m for monitoring. ping infra for possible KV cache warm repairs. @ops-oncall can you watch ingress queues?
ops-oncall: watching queues. no sustained queue depth increase, slight burst at 12:05 then normalizing.
Maria Chen: found sample trace: trace_id=abc123 — backend retried 3x then timed out. KV cache miss flagged false. paste log snippet:
```
[2026-03-01T12:03:10Z] TRACE abc123 route=/v1/generate status=504 backend=model-inference-east attempts=3 kv_cache_hit=false latency_ms=30500
```
Aj Patel: hotfix discussion: temporary bump gateway default request timeout 30s->35s + enable fast-retry only for idempotent endpoints? caution: retries can amplify load.
Simon Lee: don't enable broad retries. prefer circuit-breaker + graceful fallback. also increase prefix cache TTL for hot keys (config change).
Dana Ortiz: i'll open a small PR to the runbook to capture these emergency steps: routing fallback, fanout throttle, and TTL bump. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/pulls/432
Maria Chen: created deployment template for one-click fallback and posted run command in ops repo:
```
# apply fallback routing
rbctl route-set --service gateway-prod --policy prefer:model-small-v2 --ttl 10m --note "auto-fallback"
```
Aj Patel: good. plan of record: 1) merge runbook PR (Dana) 2) tune alerts (Simon) 3) template for one-click fallback (Maria) 4) postmortem + customer impact estimate (Aj). keep owners tagged.
deploy-bot: applied routing rule rtr-20260301-01 to 100% at 12:10 UTC.
IncidentBot: paging alert auto-resolved at 2026-03-01T12:14:00Z (5xx rate back under threshold). Estimated duration ~12 minutes.
Aj Patel: quick customer impact: small fraction of overall traffic (~0.02%) saw elevated 5xx during window. no major customer escalations open at this time.
Dana Ortiz: assigning myself to PR 432 and will schedule a 1h sync with runtime team to discuss cache TTL defaults and rollout checklist.
Simon Lee: i'll open alert tuning PR to reduce noisy pages; propose increasing evaluation window to 10m for non-critical routes and adding anomaly-suppression for rollout windows.
Maria Chen: i'll prepare the one-click rollback/fallback doc and add runbook commands to the ops console. also will add a telemetry widget for prefix cache miss heatmaps.
ops-oncall: will monitor for 2 hours and escalate if we see >1% 5xx in that window.
Aj Patel: thanks everyone. leaving final note: keep incident channel open for any regression. i'll create an incidents postmortem doc with timeline and assign follow-ups. closing pager in 30m unless regression occurs. :thumbsup:
